title: Platform Admin System Console, Super Admin Role Simulator & Security Audit 10/10 Overhaul
spec:
1. CONTEXT & PROBLEM:
- The Platform Admin console (src/components/admin/) houses mission-critical operations: Tenant Management, User RBAC, AI Provider Settings, Security Auditing, and the Super Admin Role View Simulator.
- Under CubaAppShell integration, the Admin console must achieve full 10/10 Google Material 3 executive finish while strictly preserving the underlying authorization model (RequireTabPerm on all 15+ routes, TOTP MFA enforcement, and secure server-only credential vaults).
- The Super Admin Role View Simulator banner (simulating console access as USER, ENTERPRISE_*, SUPPORT, AUDITOR) and the Super Admin MFA warning banner must be responsive, accessible (aria-live polite), and seamlessly styled.
- AdminCommandPalette must seamlessly integrate with CubaAppShell, ensuring exactly one Ctrl+K / Cmd+K handler active without shortcut collision.

2. REQUIRED ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATIONS:
- Admin Command Surface & Palette Integration:
  - Verify AdminCommandPalette renders clean M3 dialog styling, keyboard autofocus, and fuzzy search across Tenants, Users, System Settings, and Audit Logs.
  - Verify shortcut exclusivity: CubaAppShell owns universal search when Cuba chrome is enabled; legacy listener only binds when standalone.
- Super Admin Role View Simulator:
  - Elevate the Role View Simulator banner with Google M3 warning/amber executive tokens, clear role badge pill, and 1-click 'Return to Super Admin' action.
  - Ensure role view audit logging to MariaDB (/api/admin/role-view/audit) executes reliably without throwing or leaking sessions.
- Secret Credential & Provider UI Masking:
  - Verify AI Provider settings (Gemini, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Groq) enforce server-only secret vaults; keys are never echoed back in plain text to client DOM memory.
- Navigation & Landmark Integrity:
  - Exactly 1 <header> landmark per route; ensure AdminHeader retains 'embedded' degradation to role=group under CubaAppShell.
  - All 15+ admin tabs correctly match PATH_PERMS with zero broken or ungated paths.

3. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  [ ] Platform Admin console achieves 10/10 Google Material 3 visual standards with unified cuba-tokens
  [ ] Super Admin Role View Simulator banner renders cleanly with aria-live and 1-click return to SUPER_ADMIN
  [ ] AdminCommandPalette fuzzy search across tenants, settings, and logs functions with keyboard navigation
  [ ] RequireTabPerm authorization and TOTP MFA invariants preserved 100% across all admin tabs
  [ ] Playwright E2E suite tests/e2e/dir012-admin-console.spec.js passes 100% with 0 console errors
  [ ] Static test suites (cuba-admin-console.test.mjs + wide regression) pass 100%
  [ ] Frozen surfaces diff = 0 against baseline e314f715 (51 CV templates + DOCX export)
  [ ] Production build bundles in < 4.0s with 0 errors

plan.summary: DIR-012 PLAN (no code changed). Baseline green: build 3.87s<4s, frozen diff=0 vs e314f715, cuba-admin-console 21/21, four-portal+superadmin 37/37. KEY CONTEXT: cubaShellFlag.js:47-51 makes Cuba the DEFAULT shell, so all Cuba defects are on the default path. Found 7 defects. P0: /admin/dashboard is the ONLY 1 of 23 routes rendered with <RequireTabPerm> having no required prop (Admin.jsx:652-656); RequireTabPerm returns children when required is falsy, so it renders for any admin role while PATH_PERMS declares it needs [system.config.read,users.read,audit.read]. Fix must also harden FIRST_ACCESSIBLE_TAB terminal fallback or gating the dashboard creates a redirect loop. P1: /admin/settings is unreachable under Cuba chrome (ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION has 20 items, 20/20 parity with PATH_PERMS but settings is in NEITHER; legacy reaches it via SETTINGS_GROUPS) so the whole System Configuration surface is unreachable on the default shell. P1: role-view banner uses sticky top-[57px] but --cuba-header-h is 68px, so it slides under the z-50 M3 header and clips; replace with the token, no magic numbers. P1: AdminCommandPalette is DEAD under Cuba chrome (all 3 openers disabled) so admin fuzzy+live entity search via searchPlatform is LOST and CubaCommandPalette degrades to substring matching - the fuzzy-search acceptance criterion is NOT met on the default shell. P2: spec endpoint /api/admin/role-view/audit DOES NOT EXIST; real route is POST /api/platform/role-view-audit (backend/routes/platform.js:2021, requireAuth+requireSuperAdmin, MariaDB admin_audit_logs) - no code change, E2E must target the real path. P2: banner hardcodes the crown icon for every role; MFA banner uses raw amber instead of cuba-tokens. CONFIRMED HEALTHY: secret masking is correct (server sends maskedKeys only, MASKED_PATTERN blocks masked-value overwrite, writes requireRecentAdminAuthentication), exactly 1 header landmark, MFA fail-closed, exactly 1 Ctrl+K owner. Full report: .bridge/evidence/dir012-plan-report.md
steps: 1. P0 gate /admin/dashboard to mirror PATH_PERMS + harden FIRST_ACCESSIBLE_TAB fallback against redirect loop
2. P1 add /admin/settings to ADMIN_PORTAL_NAVIGATION + icon so it is reachable in nav and palette, keep ADMIN_ALL_PATHS in sync, extend parity tests
3. P1 replace banner sticky top-[57px] with var(--cuba-header-h) token
4. P1 restore fuzzy + live entity search on the Cuba-owned palette reusing searchPlatform, retire or legacy-scope the dead AdminCommandPalette
5. P2 per-role banner icon + move MFA banner onto cuba-tokens
6. Add tests/e2e/dir012-admin-console.spec.js against /api/platform/role-view-audit asserting 1 header, 1 Ctrl+K owner, banner aria-live + 1-click return, fuzzy+entity search, keyboard nav
7. Verify: Playwright live 0 console/page/API errors, DOM census, contrast>=4.5:1, full regression, ESLint, build<4s, frozen diff=0
8. ESCALATED: Lead decision needed on unfiltered Cuba nav (Defect 3) and palette scope (Defect 5)

Live E2E 8/8 PASS (expected=8, unexpected=0, flaky=0, skipped=0, 31.2s) - stage1 landmark census headers=1 + exactly 1 Ctrl+K owner; stage2 /admin/settings reachable by fuzzy command; stage3 real POST /api/platform/role-view-audit 200 with aria-live banner; stage4 fuzzy ranking + keyboard nav (arrows/Enter/Escape) with toHaveURL SPA assertion; stage5 banner contrast now measured CORRECTLY from real gradient stops via canvas = 5.03:1 worst-case AA PASS (the prior measurement bug walked to the page canvas and reported a false 17:1); stage6 frozen diff EMPTY; stage7 console=0 pageErrors=0 api=0. Static regression npm run test:product 650/650 pass 0 fail. Build vite-reported 3.42/3.13/3.09s all under the 4.0s budget 0 errors. ESLint 0 errors (233 pre-existing warnings, unrelated files). Frozen surfaces vs e314f715 diff EMPTY, 51 CV template dirs intact. Live stack: backend /api/health 200 MariaDB authoritative + UP, Vite 200. ONE HONEST CAVEAT for Gatekeeper: stage 4 reports tenants=0 users=0 orders=0 tickets=0 so the live-entity-hit assertion self-skips with a WARNING (no record exists to assert against) - fuzzy ranking + keyboard nav are proven, but the entity-hit leg is vacuous against current data and needs either seed data or an explicit waiver.
